articleTitle: The intelligent control based on synergetic pattern recognition
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: To study the synergetic theory and the basic method of synergetic pattern recognition, an intelligent control model based on synergetic pattern recognition was presented. The application research showed that the model is effective, and has good stability and strong robustness. Synergetic pattern recognition method has a promising development in future, and provides a new approach in improving intelligent control system.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis model for coking system based on multi-agent
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Aiming at the requirement on complexity, security and timeliness for fault diagnosis of coking process, the multi-agent fault diagnosis model for coking system was proposed by the hiberarchy analysis on coking system fault. Fuzzy relationship matrix knowledge model, learning mechanism based on genetic algorithm and fuzzy diagnosis reasoning process were discussed as an example of coking heating system fault diagnosis. It was validated through actual data that the model can diagnose fault efficiently and exactly and it can fulfill the requirement of production.

articleTitle: A method of single and both fault locating and evaluating through nullor substitution on tree type power network
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The problem of fault diagnosis of a tree type power network with single or both short-circuit or open-circuit and a contact resistance of arbitrary value between lines is studied. Based on nullor substitution, the method presented here is suitable for fault locating and contact resistance evaluating. Principles of diagnosis are discussed, diagnosis equations are established, and diagnosis algorithms are presented. Finally, examples for diagnosis a five-branches tree-type power network with short-circuit and open-circuit are given.

articleTitle: Friction-attenuation control design for unstable nonminimum-phase systems
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The dry friction in an unstable non-minimum-phase system can cause a self-sustained oscillation. The state feedback design can do nothing with such oscillations. If the non-minimum-phase is stabilized by output feedback, as is well known, an inner fast loop is generally needed to guarantee the robustness. It is pointed out that the friction can be attenuated by the fast loop with additional compensation design. A novel H/sub /spl infin// design methodology is proposed for this two-loop system, in which the dynamics of the inner loop is treated as unmodeled dynamics, while the order of the controller can also be reduced. Such a design is a typical example of applying H/sub /spl infin// control theory to multi-loop systems.

articleTitle: The application of feedback linearized guidance law in the homing guidance of the aerocraft
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: In the homing guidance of an aerocraft, the most important part is the precision of guidance. When the target is unmoved or moving in a constant rate, we can gain a high guidance precision by PN (proportional navigation). However, when the target move in a variable rate or in an accelerate rate or the initial aerocraft's heading is far from smash course, we cannot gain perfect guidance precision. Using feedback linear guidance law (FLGL), we can resolve such problem of guidance precision.

articleTitle: Bearings-only multiple maneuvering target tracking using sensor-array based on MHEKF, PDA/JPDA
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: "Fake points" come into being in the bearings-only multitarget-tracking system. The method of multihypothesis extended Kalman filter (MHEKF) can only partly eliminate them. To solve it more completely, a new method of sensor array is proposed. First, we used a pre-processing technique to avoid the nonlinearization in the observation function. Secondly, based on the fake points' property and geometry, we eliminated them nearly complete using sensor-array. Thirdly, track initialization implemented the idea of the MHEKF and track maintenance using the PDAF or JPDAF algorithm subsectionally. At last, a simulation of two interfering targets tracking in clutter using sensor-array was simulated, the result demonstrates for the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Design and fabrication of a MEMS sensors array for detecting explosive particles
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: In this work, a design of MEMS sensors array which is capable of detecting explosive particles is presented. The array consists of 12 silicon beams, on each beam there are a heating element and a temperature sensing element. All silicon beams can be heated up to melting point of particular kind of explosive by the heating elements, while the sensing elements are used to monitor the temperature change of each beam caused by heat absorption of the explosive particles when they melt. The MEMS sensors array has been fabricated and tested, experimental results show that it is capable of detecting TNT and RDX particles of several micrograms.

articleTitle: Ontology-based intelligent information extraction system on the semantic Web
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: This paper presents an intelligent information extraction system based on ontology on the semantic Web. It describes the kernel architecture of the system, and introduces the formal representation of ontology in detail. It also describes the ontology mapping and ontology evolution process. Lastly, the paper shows the structure of the intelligent information extraction system.

articleTitle: Research and development of the vacuum type dejectas collecting device on high-speed train
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Firstly the increasing domestic demand and the developing situation of dejectas collecting device were analyzed briefly. A new design of the vacuum type dejectas collecting device was contrived. Then its structural characteristics, operation mode and testing were introduced.

articleTitle: A method of suppliers evaluation based on Fuzzy Decision & AHP in SCM
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: In AHP, it is difficult to transform a evaluation matrix to some coherence one. Some factors are easy to satisfy coherence. We chose AHP. Since others are hard, we choose the method of Fuzzy-Decision. In building the system of suppliers evaluation in SCM, it is practical to choose, subdivide and fit together the 23 basic factors Weber suggested. Evaluation factors are classified as two types: qualitative one and quantitative one. To get the evaluation result, the first one is decided by expert, the other is based on data, to process the data, subjection-function method and frequency method are suggested.

articleTitle: Design of three-axis flight simulator controller based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The control system of three-axis flight simulator was required to have excellent dynamic tracing performance as well as fine noise-restrained property because the coupling in the frames of the flight simulator and the indeterminate time-invariant disturber in the hydraulic pressure system exists. Based on the characteristic of three-axis flight simulator, two-degree-of-freedom PID controller for outer-frame of flight simulator was designed. This type of controller had the capability of tracing target value as well as restraining noise. In addition, the outer-frame controller parameters were set based on improved genetic algorithm. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the controller. At the same time, the controller, which was designed based on the nominal model, is used on the other model. Simulation results show that the controller has the property of robustness.

articleTitle: Fuzzy neural network control of uncertain parameters system
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: According to the practical situation of wastewater treatment process, nonlinear model of activated sludge wastewater system is turned into uncertain parameters model. To this model, controllability and stability analysis are given and a state feedback to improve its stability is designed. A fuzzy neural network controller is proposed for this model, and by means of simulation the result shows that such application is feasible. When compared with traditional fuzzy control, this fuzzy neural network control strategy shows excellent robust and good dynamic characteristics to control the above uncertain parameters system.

articleTitle: Self-adaptive routing method based on learning classifier systems
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Successful computer and Internet networks require carefully designed routing protocols. The authors report on their attempt to apply evolutionary computations - that is, to place a learning classifier system on individual routers - to solve routing problems. We found that learning classifier systems are capable of fulfilling traditional routing protocol tasks (e.g., establishing routing tables) after a short period of training. Furthermore, they are capable of adapting to changing network environments and choosing the most efficient path available. Results from our experiments show that the system outperforms shortest path algorithms.

articleTitle: A study of using automatic text indexing to analyze Web browsing behavior
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: In our study, we used the agent technique to record the users browsing behavior on the WWW, and dissect the unique user by browser cookie. In order to analyze the users browsing behavior, we used the automatic text indexing to find out the key-click of user browsing behavior. In the reporting system, we integrated the OLAP (On-Line Analytical Processing) technique, pivot table, and statistic chart to present the user status of the Web site. A field experiment was conducted in this study. The subject was an Internet bookstore. Finally, we constructed the prototype system to prove the feasibility of this study.

articleTitle: A new task model for COTS-based N-modular redundant systems
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: N-modular redundancy are widely used in the ultra-reliable real-time fault-tolerant systems. Previous NMR systems often relay on special hardware and special operating systems, and the relationship between the critical tasks and operating system is tight, so it's difficult to system's porting, updating and maintenance. In this paper, we present a new task model for COTS-based NMR systems. By taking full advantage of COTS operating system's kernel function, this model not only satisfies the real-time requirement, but also masks the complexity of NMR system, and gets rid of the defect of previous systems. We also analyzed the real time performance of the tasks that adopt this new model.

articleTitle: Stability of uncertain systems with time-varying delays
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: This paper provides a new criterion for robust asymptotical stability of a class of uncertain systems with multiple time-varying delays and nonlinear uncertainties based on LaSalle theorem. Firstly, we gave a contractive invariant set for time-delay systems, and then we derived the condition in which the system would be attracted into this invariant set based on LaSalle Theorem. Time delays are assumed to be arbitrary time-varying and upper-bounded. Compared with some existing results, our results are less conservative and easy to check. Numerical examples illustrate our main results.

articleTitle: Secure communication based on synchronization of a unified chaotic system
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Since chaotic signal has a broad spectrum and is noise like, it is suitable for information encryption. Chaotic encryption is superior to key-based encryption as its speed is almost unrelated with key length. This paper presents an improved secure communication algorithm based on a unified system. The algorithm is used for encrypting and decrypting both continuous signals and discrete signals such that of a digital image. Especially, it avoids eigenfrequency assumptions for transmitted signals. Theoretical proof and numerical simulations show its high secure level and feasibility.

articleTitle: Similarity learning based on extension logic
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Based on extension logic, this paper presents a novel learning method-similarity learning method. Similarity learning is a kind of learning driven by domain knowledge. The goal is to solve incompatible problems. It starts from the key characteristics of the goal and condition of original problems. During similarity learning, the extensibility is analyzed first, and then similarity goals of the original goals and corresponding similarity condition of original condition are considered. Finally, similarity transformations based on the principles of similarity transformations are made and thus the feasible satisfactory similarity solutions for similarity problems constitute similarity solutions for the original problems. Similarity learning has also a tradeoff between exploration and exploitation. The search process of similarity objects and similarity transformations is both a kind of trial-and-error search and data mining process. It differentiates from reinforcement learning in that it is expanded based on similarity biases and not on probability biases.

articleTitle: Robust guaranteeing-cost stability for discrete time-delay systems with nonlinear perturbation
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The problems of robust stability and robust stability with a guaranteeing-cost for time-delay systems with nonlinear perturbation are discussed. A sufficient criterion for robust stability is established in a LMI framework and a linear convex optimization problem with LMI constraints for computing maximal perturbation bound is proposed. Meanwhile, a sufficient criterion for robust stability with a guaranteeing-cost for such systems is obtained, and an optimal procedure for decreasing the value of guaranteeing cost is put forward. An example illustrates the efficiency of our results.

articleTitle: Data rectification based on Bayesian network
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Mass balance model is the basis of data rectification, however, in industrial applications, model is changed when scheduling is performed. There are few good ways to deal with this problem. A new method is thus proposed based on Bayesian network, which can be used to put discussions about causality on a solid mathematical basis. By using Bayesian network scheme can be inferred from key variables. Accordingly, mass balance equation is modified in time when the scheduling events happen. In this way, the feasibility of data rectification is enhanced, so reliable information can be provided for ClMS (computer integrated manufacture system).

articleTitle: A Pr/T-Net model for context-free language parsing
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: This paper presents a Context-Free Grammar-Predicate/Transition-Net (CFG-Pr/T-Net) model for the parsing of context-free language. The places are defined to represent the states of the parsing process. The conditions and actions carried by the transitions are defined such that non-terminal symbols being processed can be rewritten and the derivation can be made to grow. Data structures, as the personalities of the token, are defined such that the growing derivation can be stored in the token. An application example was examined and the result shows that the Pr/T-Net model can do syntactic parsing successfully. The CFG-Pr/T-Net overcomes the limitation of pushdown automata, which only judged whether a string belonged to a given context free language, but were not able to answer the question concerning syntactic structure.

articleTitle: Application of SMB adsorption dynamic mixing cell model in the simulation system of PX unit
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: On the basis of process analysis, a dynamic mixing cell model of simulated moving bed (SMB) adsorption process of C/sub 8/ aromatics was developed. The model assumed an equivalent counter-current movement of the solid phase, and the mass transfer between fluid and particle was described by the linear driving force model. Together with other unit models, it was applied to the simulation system of PX industrial unit for operator training. The study indicates that this model is convenient and accurate for simulating the dynamic state of the SMB system.

articleTitle: Stability analysis for linear time-varying switched systems based on matrix measure
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The paper analyzes the stability of switched systems with linear and time-varying system matrices. The first part, present two concepts: the equal-time interval (ETI) switching sequence and the periodic switching sequence. Under periodic switching sequences derive sufficient conditions for stability and instability of the systems based on matrix measure theory. Time-invariant conditions are further simplified. Two examples are given to illustrate the effectiveness of the results.

articleTitle: The application of information entropy theory on the fault diagnosis and the evaluation of the performance of hydraulic generator sets
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The fault diagnosis and the evaluation of the performance of hydraulic generator sets (HGSs) is a hotspot of the research on hydraulic system. In this paper, the parameters correlating with the performance of HGSs are analyzed primarily. The index of evaluation of general performance is established on information entropy by fused information of time, frequency domain, fault probability and running condition. These indexes are applied in the evaluation of performance of HGSs,. It is proved that these productions are effective to the evaluation of machine sets steadiness.

articleTitle: Robust decentralized control for uncertain interconnected systems with time-varying delays
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: In this paper, the problem of robust decentralized memoryless control is investigated for a class of uncertain interconnected linear systems with state and input time-varying delays. By conducting proper Lyapunov universal function and using LMIs and vector inequalities, we present sufficient conditions to stabilize the closed-loop system asymptotically. Based on the existence of the results of LMIs, a type of memoryless linear controller is developed. Finally, a numerical example is presented to illustrate the results given in this paper and simulation shows that the method is very effective.

articleTitle: A wavenet-ES integrated fault diagnosis system for cracking furnace
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: A kind of integrated FDD approach based on wavenet and ES was studied for the practical application in industrial cracking furnace. The FDD system was based on the data from field-site. It was constructed as several independent wavelet sub-networks designed for each kind of process fault, and all sub-networks' outputs were sent into the decision fusion system (ES) to give an integrated diagnosis result for the cracking furnace process. Deep process knowledge of experts and operators was incorporated in the decision fusion system to support reasonable decision results. Simulation tests were conducted for each kind of faults. The result shows that the system has high confidence, robust, and good practicability.

articleTitle: Delay-dependent stability condition for systems with distributed delays
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The delay-dependent stability of a class of linear systems with distributed delays was investigated. By choosing proper Lyapunov function, delay-dependent stability conditions of this class of systems are formulated in terms of existence of positive definite solutions to a linear matrix equation. These conditions can be used to obtain a maximum allowable delay bound for the systems studied. These conditions are easy to be checked and can give a much less conservative delay bound than the existing methods. An example is given to show the efficiency of the obtained results.

articleTitle: Stabilizing decomposition of a class of nonlinear neutral time-variant large-scale control systems
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The stabilizing decomposition problem was put forward for nonlinear neutral time-variant large-scale control systems with multi-group multi-delay. The equivalence method of Lyapunov decomposition was used and the analysis results for linear time-variant isolated control subsystems without time-delay were applied to this paper. The sufficient condition is obtained for stabilizing decomposition problem of a class of nonlinear neutral time-variant large-scale control systems with multi-group multi-delay, and the time-delay bounded is given.

articleTitle: Space voltage vector PWM control of three-level rectifiers based on single neuron
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The principle of space voltage vector pulse width modulation (PWM) of three-level rectifiers was described. The control structure of three-level rectifiers was presented. A current controller based on single neuron was designed. Computer simulation results indicate that the three-level rectifiers with single neuron controller has ideal output current and voltage in the case of varying load and nonlinear load. If the condition of the reference value of reactive current changes, the current in the power network still has ideal output. The current controller with single neuron is easy to be implemented and shows a good application prospect.

articleTitle: Application of the multi-agent approach in responsive manufacturing modeling
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: This paper describes a responsive manufacturing system based on a heterogeneous hierarchy of agents of three types that reflect the managerial structure of manufacturing enterprises. The system is not only capable of responding rapidly to dynamic changes to fulfil customer needs but enable the utilization of manufacturing resources to be dynamically optimized. In addition, to improve the system efficiency, this paper also introduces a called qua-base acquaintance model which might facilitate the multi-agent internal communication.

articleTitle: Research of VEIS based on MAS
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Aiming at the questions of multi-domain in VE (Virtual Enterprise), an information system architecture of VE based on MAS (Multi-Agent System) is presented, in which a business process division and domain modeling approaches are employed to handle the complex and mutable problems in VE. In order to illustrate this approach, its prototype and implementation are also presented. Research results show that this framework has the capabilities of openness and dynamic reengineering. Moreover, it can solve the multi-domain problems existing in VE and can provide the circumstance for cooperation and collaboration among agents.

articleTitle: Software design and development of control system for the polyethylene reactor
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Under the background of the gas-fluidized polyethylene reactor, this paper studied the framework and implementation of computer integrated control system for the industrial process equipment. First, on the basis of technique characters and design requirements of the control system, a four-tie system framework including process layer, data layer, control layer and user interface layer was proposed and functions were respectively analyzed. Then based on the full consideration of polyethylene techniques, the design of real-time database, Web-based process monitor user interface and data interchange in between the control layers were emphatically discussed. Finally, the industry actual application of the system was briefly analyzed.

articleTitle: Periodic time-varying controller design of a satellite using magnetorquers
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Satellite attitude control that utilizing momentum bias and magnetic control is a class of complicated linear quasi-periodic system. According to asymptotical stability theorem of linear time-varying system, a new approach to magnetic controller design is presented in this paper. Simulation result is given. It is shown that high pointing accuracy of roll/yaw is achieved.

articleTitle: Study on a new approach of municipal hourly water demand prediction
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Various factors that affected the municipal water demand and characteristics of municipal hourly water demand series were analyzed. Based on these, wavelet neural networks' prediction models with periods of 24 and 168 hours were presented for working days and weekends respectively. In addition, the models were trained with gradient method. Finally, hourly water demand series of one city were predicted and compared with corresponding real values. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed wavelet neural networks prediction models. At the same time, this type of hourly water demand prediction method can meet the demand of modeling and optimal dispatch of water supplying system.

articleTitle: Robust adaptive control of X-Y position table with uncertainty
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Friction is abroad in a machine system. X-Y position table is a class device in a modern manufacture. The friction is an obstacle to improve the precision of position. A kind of robust adaptive control method has been proposed, it can realize the X-Y position table motion control of the friction is regarded as a kind of extent disturbance. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Scalar weighting optimal and adaptive information fusion kalman filter with feedback
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Based on multi-sensor optimal fusion criterion weighted by scalars in the linear minimum variance sense, a scalar weighting optimal fusion Kalman filter with feedback is given for discrete linear stochastic system with multiple sensors, and it has a two-layer fusion structure. Further, an adaptive information fusion filter with feedback is also given when the process noise covariance is unknown. The fused filter and process noise covariance in the fusion center is spread to all local subsystems by feedback at each time step. And the fusion filters have better precision than any local filter does. Applying them to a radar tracking system shows their effectiveness.

Author Keywords: optimal fusion criterion weighted by scalars

articleTitle: Synthesizing fuzzy logic systems based on Taylor expansion and input-output data
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Based on two fundamental fuzzy sets and input-output data of unknown nonlinear smooth functions, the fuzzy logic systems are synthesized in this paper. The Taylor expansion provides the fixed form of fuzzy IF-THEN rules. The two fundamental fuzzy sets can extract information from the Taylor expansion. Then the input-output data determine partially the parameters of the fuzzy IF-THEN rules. The remainder parameters can be determined by the partial derivatives of finite discrete functions. Finally, the simulation shows the validity of this method.

articleTitle: Robust stabilization for a class of uncertain discrete-time singular systems with time-delays
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The robust stabilization via state feedback for class discrete-time singular systems with norm-bounded parameter uncertainties is discussed. Under a series of equivalent transformation, the equivalence between this problem and the robust stabilization via state feedback for uncertain standard state-space discrete-time linear systems with time-delays is obtained. In terms of LMI, a necessary and sufficient condition that there exists a robust state feedback stabilizing controller for all admissible uncertainties is given, the design method of the memoryless state feedback controller and a controller is also given.

articleTitle: A genetic methodology for reachability evaluation of manipulators
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: In the process of manipulator design, reachability is an essential constrained condition. Because determining reachable position/orientation workspace is very difficult and reachability evaluation is very complicated. According to the concept of distance metrics in configuration space, we defined a distance between a target and a workspace by taking into consideration the position and orientation. If the distance is zero the manipulator can reach this target point. Reachability evaluation can be transformed into a high nonlinear optimization problem. A genetic methodology for reachability evaluation of manipulators is presented. The effectiveness and convergence are ascertained by a simulation example.

articleTitle: Chemical process monitoring and fault diagnosis based on independent component analysis
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Multivariate statistical process control (MSPC) has been successfully applied to performance monitoring and fault diagnosis for chemical processes. However, classical methods of MSPC are based on the premise that the separated latent variable must be subjected to normal distribution, which sometimes can't be satisfied. In this paper, a new method based on independent component analysis OCA) whose goal is to find a line representation of nomgaussian data to depict the chemical process and improve the monitoring performance of the system is presented. Due to the uncertainty of the probability distribution of the independent component, the paper devises a kind of classifier with Parzen density estimation for classifjring the normal data and fault data. Then the nonisothemal CSTR is monitored and diagnosed by the present method, the simulation result verifies the effectiveness of ICA-based monitoring method.

articleTitle: Optimal combination problem of orders in cold rolling plant solved by partheno-genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The order sequence problem of cold rolling production scheduling in iron and steel enterprises was discussed. The production planning of cold rolling was regarded as a traveling salesman problem. The bounce of the width, gauge and hardness of the production orders was considered and an order sequence model of order optimal combination was suggested. A partheno-genetic algorithm is used to solve the model and the algorithm has a characteristic of genetic operation being done on a single individual. The algorithm uses a new coding method based on natural serial number and some operators such as gene exchange, gene shift. The simulation with production data shows that the algorithm suggested in this paper is feasible.

articleTitle: Two-level rolling strategy for single-machine scheduling problem with release times
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: A kind of rolling horizon procedures for single-machine scheduling problem is presented to deal with the incomplete global information at decision time. At each decision time the known information should be sufficiently considered while the size of the rolling window on the sub-problem is should be limited in order to limit computational cost. The two-level rolling horizon scheduling strategy is presented to deal with the conflict. The first-level is preliminary scheduling based on the predictive windows and the second-level is locally scheduling with terminal penalty based on the rolling windows. The estimated global performance is getting close to the ultimately realized actual cost and its getting better and better while the new information is obtained and the decision time is being put forward.

articleTitle: A novel algorithm of robust congestion control in multi-virtual-circuit ATM networks
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The congestion control plays an important role in the effective and stable operation of ATM networks. In this paper, a novel robust controller design algorithm, based on Smith principle, is presented for ATM congestion control in which multiple virtual circuits are throttled at a single intermediate node. This rate-based congestion control algorithm can improve the QoS (quality of service) of ABR flow, which can guarantee the fairness, maintain queue length of a bottleneck node at a desired level and the robustness of stable operation networks. Theoretical and experimental results show the mechanism has the advantages of the fairness of bandwidth allocation, fast convergence and the robustness for networks uncertainties.

articleTitle: Hierarchical interactive evolutionary computation and its application in fashion design
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The idea of hierarchy was introduced to interactive evolutionary computation and hierarchical interactive evolutionary computation was put forth aiming on inefficient local search problem of current interactive evolutionary computation. The issues to implement were presented. The efficiency of the algorithm was analyzed. The algorithm was applied to fashion design and the calculating example validates its efficiency.

articleTitle: Study of multivariable predictive functional control for reheats temperature system
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Reheats temperature system control directly influences the economical efficiency of power plant. For reheats temperature process with steam-steam exchanger, dealing with the coupling and time delay characteristics of object is a critical problem. Based on the SISO predictive functional control for first order plant with large delay, a multivariable algorithm is proposed. With the single value prediction, the multivariable control equation is optimized from performance function of all output sums, where the MIMO plant is described by first order model with delay. Delay compensation is also inserted by using Smith prediction. The simulations of reheat temperature demonstrate the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Robust learning of neural networks ensemble for modeling
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Neural networks ensemble (NNE) has recently attracted great interests because of their advantages over single neural networks (SNN) as the ability of universal approximate and generalization. However, the performance of NNE trained by least squares methods deteriorates when lots of outliers emerge in I/O data. In this paper, a robust learning algorithm of NNE is applied based on the theory of robust regression that may deal well with the problems of outliers. Initial empirical study demonstrates that the robust learning algorithm of NNE has better precision and generalization than both neural networks ensemble with least square function and single neural network with the same robust algorithm do, when trained under the data with outliers.

articleTitle: Research on chaos performance of vortex signal
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The chaos theory is introduced to study on the performance of vortex flow signal. The paper first analyzes the possibility that vortex noise signal should be in possession of chaos characteristic, and then undertakes simulation computation on the Lyapunov exponent of vortex flow signal by chaos theory. Its result approves that vortex flow signal has chaos characteristic. Finally, the paper picks up the chaos characteristic of vortex flow signal and calculates its box-dimension. The simulation result of data demonstrates the feasibility of research on performance of vortex signal by chaos theory.

articleTitle: Design of SIMUPRO series training simulators for large scale industrial processes
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Training simulator can model all phenomena of startup, shutdown, routine operation and malfunction in actual factory without any raw materials and danger. An operator trained by training simulator for several weeks can get more experiences than one working in the field for two to five years. As a scientific training method, training simulator is attracting more and more considerable attentions. SIMUPRO series training simulators for large scale industrial processes developed by Zhejiang University, have been successfully applied in many petrochemical works where distributed control systems (DCS) are used. SIMUPRO series training simulators are remarked well by broad users for their advanced technology, practicability and reliability. The functions, architectures, designs and characters of these training simulators are elucidated in this work.

articleTitle: Research on digital filtering of the gap sensor
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The characteristics of noise were analyzed for the gap sensor in maglev train. A combination of FIR filter and predictive algorithm was designed for efficient noise reduction. Compared with the other window functions, Kaiser function was chosen for the FIR filter. This allows trade-off between transition bandwidth and stop-band attenuation by changing the shape parameter /spl beta/. A new predictive algorithm was deduced and adopted against strong impulsive noise, which decreases time delay from median filter. These methods were validated by simulation and experiment respectively. S/N ratio of the gap sensor is increased effectively.

articleTitle: A robust fault detection and isolation method via sliding mode observer
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: A robust fault detection and isolation (FDI) approach for a class of nonlinear systems with uncertainty was presented. The FDI scheme was based on sliding mode observer, which was robust against system uncertainty. Fault detection can be realized by use of sliding boundary size. When the fault had been detected, the estimate part in the observer for the fault can be enabled. A radial basis function (RBF) neural network was used to approximate the fault, so making the fault isolation a simple task. The theoretic analysis guaranteed the convergence of the observer. Simulation results show the feasibility of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Decentralized output tracking control of a class of large-scale nonlinear systems via output feedback
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The problem of decentralized output tracking is addressed for a class of large-scale nonlinear systems. By introducing a new type of high-gain observers and using the recursive procedure, we present a procedure for constructing decentralized output feedback controllers under a Lipschitz condition. The proposed controllers achieve the exponential asymptotic tracking of the given constant reference signals while maintaining internal boundedness. Finally, simulation shows the effectiveness of our result.

articleTitle: Model-following reference adaptive control for a class of composite systems
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The model-following reference adaptive control problem is discussed for a class of large-scale composite systems. A new idea is given: according to the expected performance, add the interconnected terms to the reference model. Based on Lyapunov theory, the adaptive control law is given and the global uniformly convergence is proved.

articleTitle: On practical stability for large scale impulsive control system in terms of two measurements
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: In this paper, we study the (h/sub 0/, h)-practical stability of large scale dynamic system with impulsive solution. By using comparison principle, scalar and vector Lyapunov functions and impulsive different inequalities, we obtain some sufficient conditions of the (h/sub 0/, h)-practical stability for large scale impulsive dynamic system in terms of two measurements.

articleTitle: Motion and real-world sensing system of a small biped entertainment robot
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: SDR-4X II is the latest prototype model which is a small biped entertainment robot. This is the improved model of SDR-4X. In this paper, we report the sensing system of this robot which is important and essential for a small biped entertainment robot which will be used in a home environment. One technology is the design of the motion sensing system. This technology are the inclination sensor system and the force sensor system which obtains the inclination of the trunk and the foot with force. Another technology is the real-world sensing system. Another one is the touch sensing system. The robot is used in a normal home environment, so we should strongly consider the safety of humans. Another is the vision sensor system. The configuration and the distance image acquisition are explained. Next is the audio sensor system which obtains the sound and the voice information. The hardware system and the direction recognition are explained. These sensing systems are the key to make the biped robot walk and its dynamic motion highly stable and understand the real-world around the robot.

articleTitle: Dynamic management of real time QoS according to (m, k)-firm
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: A model of real time QoS (quality of service) according to constraint of (m, k)-firm offers more flexibility and a better use of resources compared to guaranteed QoS. It opens new prospects for the implementation of the adaptive management mechanisms of QoS in real time networks and systems. To take into account this new type of constraint during the scheduling of access to the resources, the scheduling algorithms of QoS developed for the hard real time system (for example EDF, FP) and for the hard real time network (for example WFQ) must be extended. This article first presents a state of the art on the principal scheduling algorithms developed for the real time (m, k)-firm guarantee, then two algorithms of our recent work: E-DBP and (m, k)-WF/sup 2/Q. We also define the notion of the gracious degradation of QoS according to (m, k)-firm and discuss its application to dynamic management of QoS in the networks.

articleTitle: A digital portable instrument for A-scan ultrasonic flaw inspection
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Based on ultrasonic nondestructive examination, an A-scan flaw inspection instrument is developed. It is an intelligent instrument, which is used to detect flaws in steel plates and is automatic inspection and alarming. In this article, system hardware structure is introduced, the data processing unit is described and especially the method to realize high-speed data processing is presented. The instrument is processed with wave peak values and can realize real-time A-scan display of echo on a screen. At the same time, distance-amplitude-curve (DAC) and system working parameters are displayed on the screen too. The inspection results can be stored or printed. System parameters can be set according to the practical inspection requirements. The main characteristics of the instrument are mini outlook, lightweight and low power consumption, which make it a more portable and more convenient device than those conventional ones.

articleTitle: Design the monitor and control system of network manufacture company based on Web services
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Network monitor and control system is applied in many modern manufacture companies. For using it on Internet more suitably, we propose a design plan based on Web services, which illustrates how to design a network monitor and control system of manufacture companies from three aspects: Internet, company LAN and field bus.

articleTitle: A polymer-based microfluidic mixing system driven by vortex micropumps
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: This paper describes a polymer-based microfluidic mixing system developed by integrating two vortex micropumps and a micromixer. Fluid transmission with steady flow rate is driven by the circumrotating motion of the impellers in the micropumps. The mixing principle is based on the ultrasonic wave generated by the PZT substrate oscillation. We will illustrate the designs, the fabrication processes and the operation theories of both devices. Experiments will be conducted to investigate the performance of the mixing system.

articleTitle: Evaluating the significance of system parameters with uncertain methods and its application
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: It is important to evaluate the significance of system parameters in engineering, especially for reducing the dimension and complexity of system. The rough sets theory is introduced into evaluation the significance of system. A parameter defined by the concepts of lower and upper approximation in rough sets theory is used to estimate the significance of system parameters. The proposed method in the article is applied in fault analysis of diesel engine's plunger and the result matches the practical one. We can get more information of the system by this method comparing with the other methods, such as K-W method and method based on information entropy.

articleTitle: Hybrid control of backstepping incorporated with L/sub 2/-gain analysis for aircraft attitude
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: A novel hybrid control approach of backstepping incorporated with L/sub 2/-gain analysis for attitude control of aircraft systems with external disturbance and uncertainties is presented. An explicit solution to the nonlinear H/sub /spl infin// attitude control problem can be obtained by combining backstepping and variable structure control techniques. The attitude controller achieves good performance, and the unknown disturbance is attenuated. Finally, nonlinear six-degree-of-freedom simulation results for the aircraft model are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control law.

articleTitle: GA&LS-based Fuzzy Neural Network control
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: With its stochastic but directional research mechanism, Genetic Algorithm (GA) was used to optimize the global parameters and structure of Fuzzy Neural Network (FNN), membership functions of premise of network reasoning rule were adjusted by GA offline, while network weights of outcome were dynamically modified by least square (LS) algorithm online. The two algorithms worked harmoniously so as to improve the performance of network. Rotary inverted pendulum was utilized to examine control performance and feature of the approach proposed. The result of experiment shows the validity of method presented, the system has good self-learning capability and strong robustness.

articleTitle: Directly adaptive control for a class of nonlinear system
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Directly adaptive controller for a class of nonlinear system is designed. This nonlinear system is substituted by a time-varying linear system, firstly. Then, the general structure of adaptive controller for the nonlinear system is designed. Cubic spline functions are used to identify the coefficients of time-varying controller. The stability of a closed-loop system is proved and the effectiveness of the presented method is demonstrated by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Design of missile autopilot applying the immersion and invariance algorithm
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The difficulties in designing an effective load autopilot for missile arise from highly nonlinear and non-minimum phase plant characteristics from load command to missile load output. In this paper, the method of designing controller relied upon the notion of system immersion and manifold invariance. The construction of the stabilizing control laws resembles the procedure used in nonlinear regulator theory to derive the (invariant) output zeroing manifold and its friend. The method is well suited in situations where we know a stabilizing controller of a nominal reduced order mode, which we would like to robustify with respect to higher order dynamics. This method overcomes these difficulties and the designed autopilot improves system performances.

articleTitle: Neuron controller with self-tuning gain for pH processes
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The neuron control method with self-tuning gain is proposed for a pH neutralization process in this paper. In this control system, the fuzzy T-S model is used to predict the control signal. The neuron controller gain is calculated and tuned according to the parameter estimation and experience formulas. The simulation results show that the proposed control method can control the pH process with grave nonlinearity.

articleTitle: Neural learning control
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: This paper studies neural learning control. Based on an earlier result for deterministic learning of unknown system dynamics from a stable control process, this paper provides detailed analysis on how the learned knowledge can be effectively exploited to achieve stability and improved control performance. Comparisons on neural learning control with adaptive neural control and linear control are also included. The effectiveness of the neural learning control approach is demonstrated using simulations.

articleTitle: Research on multi-module-cascaded high-power inverter digital modulation strategy and control method
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Based on multi-module-cascaded inverter structure and optimized harmonic, this paper concludes the phase-shifting SPWM modulation topology applied to multi-module-cascaded inverter, proposes the phase-shifting SPWM modulation digital method based on digital signal processor (DSP) and complex programmable logic devices (CPLD), and solves the key problem of the triangle carrier phases exactly locked. The validity of the proposed method is verified through simulation and experiments. At the same time, a multiple-loop control scheme for single-phase high-power inverter is proposed. The proposed multiple-loop control scheme incorporates an inner current loop with an outer voltage loop. The corresponding control gains are designed through deadbeat theory so that the inverter can achieve fast dynamic response. A load disturbance compensation scheme has been proposed to improve the stiffness of the inverter. The validity of the proposed control scheme is verified through simulation and experiments.

articleTitle: Progress of smart sensor and smart sensor networks
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Rapid development of industrial applications imposes more challenges on traditional sensors that only provide raw signal. As a trend, smart sensor and smart sensor network sensors are getting more attention in industrial areas for the values they can bring into the system. One way or another, sensor data will ultimately be used for control purpose. Smart sensor and smart sensor networks will go beyond raw signal and/or data, and provide certain level of information and/or knowledge, which can significantly improve the overall control system performance and reduce reliability. This paper gives a brief introduction on smart sensor and smart sensor networks and their progresses. Some issues observed are also highlighted. By raising people's attention and interests, authors believe that researchers/developers from both academic and industrial societies can and should work together to address those issues and promote the development of smart sensor and smart sensor networks.

articleTitle: Methodology and technology of Design For Cost (DFC)
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Design for X(DFX) is the key technology in concurrent engineering. Design for cost (DFC) is a branch in DFX. DFC is a design method which analyze and evaluate a product's life cycle cost (LCC), then modify the design to reduce the LCC. In order to realize DFC, some key technologies were proposed: LCC model; design result's evaluation and generation of design suggestions; integration of DFC and other DFX methods. DFC's conceptual model included design tools, LCC estimation methods base, feature mapping and decision-making support system. Using Group Technology and feature modeling technology, a general concept model of DFC was developed at the detail design stage. The Activity-Based Costing (ABC) method was used to estimate product LCC in the conceptual model. Finally, a structure of LCC estimation methods base was established using agents. It can be used to estimate the LCC of mechanical parts and products.

articleTitle: Research on mathematical transmission model of SARS based on molecular kinematics
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Based on molecular kinematics and other related jobs, an explicit analytical mathematical model about severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS) and the similar epidemics is put forward. New factors are considered such as resistibility of individuals and system of SARS checkpoints and health registration. Simulation based on molecular kinematics shows the analytical model is able to describe the dissemination of SARS correctly before and after the applications of various control measures, and therefore is able to predict the future epidemics. Application of the model to Beijing's epidemics presents satisfactory results. Principle of superposition is pointed out in determining the value of R in open model. Another useful conclusion is that the system of checkpoints and health registration plays critically important role. Drawbacks of the model are also discussed.

articleTitle: Advanced process control and its application to industrial distillation chain
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: For distillation section of LAB plant, this paper analyzed difficulties in process control of the industrial distillation chain. APC-Hiecon, an APC software based on model predictive control strategy, then was used to solve these problems of the distillation chain. Successful application of APC improves disturbance rejection, operation of the columns and product quality, increases economic benefit of production while reducing product consumption.

articleTitle: LMI based state feedback H/sub 2/ control of linear singular systems
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The H/sub 2/ control problem of linear singular systems was investigated through transforming the systems to standard state-space linear systems. A sufficient and necessary condition is formulated for the existence of the controller in the format of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs). The given controller guarantees that the closed-loop system is impulse-free and stable, satisfies H/sub 2/ performance. In addition, the controller contains an adjustable parameter in favor of engineering appliance.

articleTitle: Study on the modeling of nonlinear time variant systems based on neural networks combined with basis sequence expansions
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: This paper presents a new method for identifying nonlinear time variant systems. The method asks for the implementation of a procedure developed for time-variant linear systems using wavelets by Tsatsanis and Giannakis. An extension to nonlinear models is considered. The essential idea is that we regard the weights of the feedforward neural networks as a time-variant parametric vector that reflects the time-variant dynamics of the system and then this time-variant parametric vector can be expanded onto a finite set of basis sequences. Thus, a parsimonious model can be realized by this method. In order to improve the real-time capability of the algorithm, the network is trained by a simple fast learning algorithm based on the local least squares presented by the authors. The method is tested by numerical experiment.

articleTitle: A method of outliers detection based on amend sequential probabilistic ratio analysis
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Outlier detection is a statistical problem that has received considerable attention. A common approach is assuming that the (possible) outliers are generated by contaminating models. It is known that sequential probabilistic ratio analysis (ASPR) is not very sensitive to outliers. Therefore, identification of outliers is possible for exploring appropriate model structures and determining reliable estimates of parameters. This paper examines the use of amend sequential probabilistic ratio analysis for outlier detection. We develop identification indices for detecting observations that influence the SPR estimates, higher. Finally, an example is given to illustrate the daily average number of car manufacturing defects application in the proposed detection.

articleTitle: An improved genetic algorithm for JSP
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: According to the character of JSP, the paper designs a matrix coding for its population as well as relevant crossover operator and mutation operator. The algorithm adds a way to replace the lethal factor with the best individual for its reproduction strategy, and a heuristics correct operator is designed. Solving two different kinds of JSP model result in satisfied.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of independent agents-based distributed intrusion detection system
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The common problems of current intrusion detection systems (IDSs) were analyzed. On the basis of these, a distributed IDS framework model based on independent agents was proposed. This paper described the function of entities, defined the communication and alert mechanisms, and designed some detection agents. The proposed model is an open system with good scalability. There are no control analyzers in it, which avoids the problem of a single point failure. Agents are independent, while they can communicate and cooperate with one another to take actions. The experiment results show that it costs low system resources and network bandwidth. Although the prototype is realized on Linux platform, it is easy to migrate into other platforms for independence of system environment.

articleTitle: A credit scoring model using Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: A novel credit scoring model using the Support Vectors Machine (SVM) is proposed. The credits of 106 listed companies of China in 2000 and further forecast 13 pre-lost companies in 2001 are evaluated with this model. The 106 listed companies are divided into two groups: the "good" group and the "bad" group, according to their performance. Four primary financial indexes, which are income per share, net asset per share, return rate of net asset, and cash flow per share, are considered for each listed company. The simulation results show that a high classification correct rate of up to 98.11% is attained with the SVM credit scoring model. Moreover, it possesses strong adaptive ability, so it can be used to predict financial distress of the companies. The forecasting results show that the forecasting accuracy rate of the model reaches 100%.

articleTitle: A stable dual-mode fuzzy predictive control scheme for nonlinear system
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: We present a method for the construction of a stable dual-mode predictive controller of nonlinear system by using the fuzzy system as a predictive model, which can be applied to a wide class of nonlinear systems. Since the model error between the nonlinear system and the fuzzy model exists, the closed-loop stability cannot be guaranteed in the neighborhood of the origin. Hence, the dual-mode controller is designed to ensure the stability in this region. In the neighborhood of the origin, a linear feedback controller designed for the linearized system generates the control action. Outside this neighborhood, predictive controller based on the fuzzy model is applied to the real nonlinear system and to drive the trajectory of the nonlinear system to the attractive region. This method under some condition yields a stable closed-loop system when applied to nonlinear systems.

articleTitle: 3D object recognition with image gradient
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The angle between image gradient and the major principal axis of silhouette is proposed to describe 3D object, and the invariance of this description to the density, the orientation of light and the reflection of surface is also deduced in this paper. Using the moment invariants of this description can introduce more 3D information of object and bring higher recognition ratios than using the 2D moment invariant of object silhouettes.

articleTitle: Automatic sensor registration using stochastic optimization methods
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Sensor image registration is one of important problems in sensor fusion, it is the task of finding the correct mapping of one sensor image onto another. In this paper, the sensor image registration problem is approached as a optimization problem, then an appropriate fitness function is proposed to evaluate the mapping parameter set and several optimization methods (genetic algorithms, simulated annealing, hybrid strategy GASA) are adopted to solve this problem automatically. The experiment indicates the feasibility of the registration methods which are insensitive to noise. Among them, GASA shows good performance because of its rapid convergence.

articleTitle: Blind shallow-water acoustic channel estimation using frequency-domain natural gradient algorithm
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Deconvolution with a signal received on a hydrophone in shallow water is made difficult by distortions caused by dynamic multipath propagation. It is acceptable to model the shallow water channel between the source and each hydrophone receiver as a multiple time-delay attenuation channel. Blind deconvolution techniques can adapt the processing to the acoustic environment if reasonable assumptions about the nature of the underwater channel used to represent the multipath propagation can be made. A blind deconvolution methodology for shallow-water channel estimation is employed and presented here, with no prior information on characteristics of the source or the channel. The methodology is based on the natural gradient in frequency-domain to minimize the mutual information. For its high efficiency and less computational complexity it is suitable for estimation of shallow-water channel. An application example of the approach using synthetic ocean acoustic data is also presented.

articleTitle: Electrical capacitance tomography image reconstruction based on singular value decomposition
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Electrical capacitance sensor is a soft-field sensor; the number of possible independent measurements is very small compared to the number of pixels required for an acceptable image. These problems make it difficult to reconstruct good quality images on-line. Although images reconstructed using the linear back-projection (LBP) algorithm are generally qualitative rather than quantitative, and various iterative methods have been developed to obtain improved image quality, the LBP algorithm is still the most commonly used algorithm because it is fast and hence suitable for on-line use. A new reconstruction method based on singular value decomposition of re-normalized sensitivity matrix is presented. Simulation research shows that it has reconstruction quality similar to that of an iteration method, and reconstruction time similar to that of the LBP algorithm.

articleTitle: Research of a universal fuzzy controller based on chaos optimization
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: A universal fuzzy controller, which can adapt to different control objects, is proposed. Controller parameters, such as the quantifying factors and the scale factor, and fuzzy control rules are optimized by chaos method, which is a combination of global and partial chaos searching. The method is applied to control three different nonlinear plants. Simulation results show that the optimization method is efficient to search for controller parameters and control rules, and the control has the advantages of strong robustness and adaptability. The algorithm has a simple structure and is easy to realize. This universal fuzzy controller is better than the common one.

articleTitle: On-line prediction of naphtha cracker product yields
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: An on-line model for the radiant section of a naphtha cracking furnace is built based on the molecular kinetics of naphtha pyrolysis. To predict the main product yields on-line, the average properties of naphtha (e.g. molecular formula, form-heat, heat conductivity coefficient and thermal capacity) and the selectivity coefficients of the primary reaction should be adjusted on-line to adapt to the gradual change of feed-in naphtha. An estimation algorithm is introduced here to calculate the average properties of naphtha based on normal physical characteristics of naphtha. The normal characteristics include ASTM D86 values (IBP, 10%, 30%, 50%, 70%, 90% and 95%), PONA values (n-paraffines, i-paraffines, naphthenes and aromatics) and density. In addition, a stochastic method is brought forward to adjust the selectivity coefficients of primary reaction. The on-line application showed that the main product yields predicted agree well with measured data from laboratory. The predicted yields also show 10 minutes ahead of chromatogram equipment. It indicates that this on-line model is effective.

articleTitle: Missile autopilot design based on second order sliding modes control
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The difficulties in designing an effective load control missile autopilot arise from highly nonlinear and non-minimum phase plant characteristics because the missile acceleration is regarded as output. To avoid the instability problem associated with unstable zero dynamics, a modified second order sliding mode controller was proposed through reconstruction of the novel sliding surface, and the suitable commutation logic of control law was introduced to prevent an uncontrollable growth of uncertainties, then the system zero dynamics can be stabilized by pole assignment. The simulation results show the validity of the proposed method in trajectory tracking and chattering attenuation.

articleTitle: Study of automobile engine fault diagnosis based on wavelet neural networks
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The engine vibration signals characters are extracted using wavelet packet technology. A model of wavelet neural networks is constructed based on wavelet frame theory and neural networks technology. Then multiresolution analysis is used to choose and optimize the wavelet neuron. The model is validated through the testing that simulates the faults of engine valve clearance. The experimental results show that the proposed automobile engine fault diagnostic model based on wavelet neural networks can diagnose the engine fault effectively.

articleTitle: Sensors reliability optimal allocation for fault tolerant control system with imperfect fault diagnosis
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The absolute reliability of a fault diagnostic device is assumed in most of reliability optimal allocation methods, and the fault diagnostic device is ignored in the system reliability model. In this paper, the hardware and software conditions on which the fault diagnostic device depends upon are analyzed. The fault diagnostic device is assumed imperfect and is regarded as a part of the whole system reliability model. Therefore, a more practical reliability optimal allocation method of a control system is provided. The method is used in sensors reliability optimal allocation of satellite attitude control system.

articleTitle: Fault-tolerant controller design with integrity against multi time-delay LTI systems
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: In this paper, the problem of robust fault-tolerant control for a kind of multi time-delay LTI systems is studied based on the Riccati function and Lyapunov's steady theorem. The output feedback control law with multi time-delay is put forward and the design method of fault-tolerant controller with integrity against actuator and sensor failures is proposed. Sufficient condition of integrity against actuator and sensor failures is given. Finally, the design method is applied and the results demonstrate that the method proposed by this paper is more effective and more stable than that of output feedback without time-delay.

articleTitle: Performance limitation in random sinusoidal signal estimation
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: This paper studies the performance limitations of an LTI SISO discrete-time system in estimating a type of random input signal from its output signal. The input signal under consideration is a random sinusoidal signal. The estimation performance is measured by the energy of certain averaged error between the output of the estimator and the signal under estimation. Our purpose is to find the fundamental limit of the best attainable estimation performance under any estimator structure and parameters, in terms of the characteristics of the given system as well as the signal under estimation. It is shown that the fundamental limit depends on the interaction between the signal under estimation and the nonminimum phase zeros of the system. Moreover, this result is extended to optimal prediction and smoothing problems.

articleTitle: A new method of position estimation for visual servoing
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: A position estimation scheme in visual servo system with single camera mounted on a robot is proposed. The scheme combines the techniques of depth-from-motion and depth-from-defocus to satisfy the real-time requirement. For long distance moving objects, the position estimation of the object is obtained by Plucker expression in Grassmann-Cayley algebra. For close distance moving object, a multilayer feedforward neural network is employed to recover the object position from defocused image. A criterion is used to switch between these two methods. The improvements of estimation accuracy by using the proposed method are verified by experimental results.

articleTitle: An abstract method for extracting goal orderings
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Extracting and using goal orderings is a way to improve efficiencies of planning algorithms. During extracting goal orderings, some of existing methods can only deal with atomic goals of a specific problem that will introduce too much redundant work, and the others deal with predicates of a planning domain that can not extract enough goal orderings. The paper addressed an abstract method to extract goal orderings. The method used unification to identify different instantiations of a predicate when dealing with predicates. It can not only reduce redundant work during extracting, but also get enough goal orderings.

articleTitle: Research on library robotic system
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The paper illuminates a new robotic system, library robotic system, which is used for identifying a requested book, retrieving it from the bookshelves, and carrying it to the destination area. Some key issues, such as map yielding, location estimation, path-following control and book identification, are discussed. The developments of mechanical system, control system, and software system are presented.

articleTitle: Multiple faces detection based on chaos-mutation niche genetic algorithms
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The traditional methods of multiple human faces detection have the disadvantages of high complexity and low accuracy. A multiple faces detection method based on chaos-mutation niche GA is proposed. This method is applied to detect the faces with complex backgrounds. The faces in the images are described based on the structure of the facial features and the grayscale distribution; Then the chaos-mutation genetic algorithm based on niche is proposed to search the input images simultaneously for potential face regions at different scales by calculating the adaptable values. The experiments show that the algorithm has reached a quite good result that the average detection accuracy is about 86% and the average implementation time for an image (with size of 256 multiply 256 pixels) is less than 1 second on PC of PIII 450.

articleTitle: Robust H/sub /spl infin// control for interval singular systems with time-delay in state
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The problem of robust H/sub /spl infin// control was discussed for a class of interval singular systems with state delay. The purpose is the design of a state feedback controller such that the resulting closed-loop system is robust stable while the closed-loop transfer function satisfies a prescribed H/sub /spl infin//-norm bound constraint. This problem is solved via the notion of generalized quadratic stabilization with H/sub /spl infin//-norm bound. Necessary and sufficient condition for generalized quadratic stabilization with H/sub /spl infin//-norm bound is derived. A required state feedback controller is also constructed. Finally, an example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Using fuzzy sets and genetic algorithm for Chinese verb classification
