An application of flow shop is presented to the validity of the proposed method that exhibits attractive performances in terms of autonomy and collaboration.

articleTitle: TSP problem based on dynamic environment
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Many real world optimization problems are related with time and some of them can be modeled by the Dynamic TSP(DTSP). A DTSP is harder than a general TSP, which is a NP-hard problem, because the city number of the DTSP is time varying. We have first given a mathematical model for DTSP. Then we have discussed the GT algorithm which is a algorithm solve static TSP problem. Based on GT algorithm, we have proposed an evolutionary algorithm, which can solve DTSP problem, given its details, analyzed its character and have given a graph of CHN144+1 problem. In the end, we have given the research area in future.

articleTitle: Necessary and sufficient conditions for robust stability of DMC
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The single-input/single-output dynamic matrix control (DMC) algorithm based on finite impulse response (FIR) model was studied. The model errors were respectively described by the upper and lower bounds and error square sum of impulse response coefficients. The robust stability criteria for DMC algorithms were proposed in the form of linear matrix inequality. These criteria can assure the closed-loop systems to be asymptotically stable, when the coefficients of characteristic polynomial do not satisfy Jury's dominant coefficient lemma.

articleTitle: Migration strategies of agent based on correlation analysis and neural network
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: A migration model based on accumulated knowledge and the key algorithms were proposed. By correlation analysis between the executed time and the host parameters, we chose the host parameters whose correlation coefficients were great as the input of neural network and the executed time as output to construct the model of neural network. With the model, agents can evaluate the performances-of the host computers according to their parameters. Thus, the agent can choose the computer with the best performance as a running platform. The simulation experiments with aglet show that the algorithms are efficient.

articleTitle: Development of DSP-based measurement system of balancing machines
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: With development of small-sized and high-speed rotor of motor products, higher precision of balancing machines is demanded. Digital signal processing method of measurement system of balancing machines was studied in detail. Several methods extracting magnitude and phase of unbalance signal - digital correlation analysis, digital phase sensitive analysis, least square fit, and frequency domain methods (FFT, DFT) were presented and clarified analytically. The significance of integral periodic signal sampling was indicated. According to characteristics of tested signals of balancing machines, a digital tracking filter method was put forward, its centre frequency can be adaptive tuned consistence with rotational speed of work-piece to realize the ability of tracking unbalance signal, so that interference in tested signals can be removed effectively. Moreover, DSP and single-chip based double CPU digital measurement system has been developed. The results of simulation and application in balancing machines show that these approaches improve largely the precision of small unbalance amount and reduce the minimum ultimate unbalance amount, and increase the reliability, stabilization and anti-jamming ability of the system.

articleTitle: Simulation support system and model base technology in cold rolling process control system
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: To simplify the process of domain simulation, reduce the development cycle and improve the reusing of simulation system, a simulation support system in industrial fields was designed based on domain model base technology. Hierarchy architecture oriented to various objects and models was abstracted from the standard simulation flow of field application. Domain model base was embedded in simulation platform to reuse main models and meta-models. Key problems like software layer and model design were discussed and the interface template among models was proposed in this paper. Finally an application example was provided. And the feasibility and practicability of the framework of support system given here are proved.

articleTitle: An intelligent human-robot interface using a probability approach
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: In the near future, mobile service robots will play important roles in human beings life. They are expected to be intelligent and powerful assistants for the human beings. Such situations require intelligent and natural interaction between human and robots. One way to facilitate this is by using a friendly natural language interface. The development of a natural language interface requires a robust natural language processor, where the major problem is the ambiguity issue. Many sentences are ambiguous in our daily life. An ambiguous sentence may have more than one meaning. In this paper, a probability approach is proposed to resolve the ambiguities in sentences for the intelligent human-robot interface.

articleTitle: Rejection of persistent bounded disturbance for a class of uncertain singular time-delay system
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: This paper considers the problem of persistent bounded disturbance rejection for a class of uncertain linear singular systems with a constant time-delay. Sufficient conditions guaranteeing the robustly internal stability and robust /spl rho/-performance of the closed-loop are derived by using Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional and generalized quadratic stability method. The disturbance rejection controller is also given through solving two strict linear matrix inequalities (LMI).

articleTitle: Precise and robust control of Permanent magnet linear synchronous motor in a high-speed feeding system
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Electromagnetic thrust and the dynamic equation were obtained by analyzing the characteristics of Permanent magnet linear synchronous motors (PMLSM) with fraction slot. Then the optimal weights were selected and a mixed-sensitivity H/sub /spl infin// velocity controller was designed according to the model uncertainties and disturbances in the feeding system. The velocity control system was developed by compensating the nonlinear friction and horizon force caused by the normal force of PMLSM and designing a disturbance observer. Simulations and experiments demonstrated that the response of the system was rapid and the tracking error was small. It also demonstrated that the PMLSM ran reliably and precisely. So the designed velocity system is satisfactory and realizable.

articleTitle: Soft sensor based on least square support vector machines for microbiological fermentation
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Microbiological fermentation is a kind of complicated batch process that is severely nonlinear and time variant. There are many process parameters need to monitor and control in order to make the microbiological fermentation process to succeed. So it is important to measure the process variables. But the instrumentation and sensors available for fermentation control do not cover all the desirable or necessary measurements. In fermentation processes, many important internal variables can't be measured. So soft sensor has become an indispensable method measure internal variables in fermentation processes. In this paper, we propose a new method of soft sensor constructed with least square support vector machine (LS-SVM) for microbiological fermentation. This method was compared with neural network in the experiment of soft sensor construction. Experiment results demonstrate this method of construction soft sensor in microbiological fermentation is very valid.

articleTitle: Connecting and disconnecting for chain reconfiguration of modular self reconfigurable robot
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Modular self-reconfigurable robot (MSRR) with many degrees of freedom and flexible reconfigurations can acclimatize itself to the change of environment. Chain reconfiguration system are capable of be reconfigured to form arbitrary chain-based topologies. This reconfiguration requires connecting and disconnecting from one point of the chain. So accurate movements of modules are needed, but this may be extremely difficult because of the internal errors in the system (especially with large numbers of modules). This paper describes the design of a kind of MSRR with chain reconfiguration and three phases of its docking process. Some methods are presented for the implements of these phases.

articleTitle: Breeder genetic algorithm based fuzzy simulation
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Fuzzy simulation is often required in fuzzy programming. In this paper, we propose the application of breeder genetic algorithm (BGA) to compute possibility and find critical values. BGA is a kind of genetic algorithm, which is especially powerful and reliable in global searching. Experiments show that BGA based fuzzy simulation has a better performance.

articleTitle: Active vibration control of a flexible plate structure based on H/sub /spl infin// mixed sensitivity
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Based on the model of a flexible plate vibration system, and using H/sub /spl infin//-based mixed sensitivity analysis method, a robust controller is established by choosing appropriate weighting functions for robust performance and stability. Simulations and experimental studies show that the dynamics and robustness of closed-loop vibration system of the flexible plate are improved.

articleTitle: A dual control method for MIMO stochastic systems
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: A new dual control method is proposed for the MIMO stochastic systems with unknown constant parameters, which converts the unsolvable dynamic programming problem into multiple single-step minimum variance control problems. In every instant, innovation is introduced to improve learning. Unknown parameters are estimated using Kalman filter and the present minimum variance control can be solved by use of the estimation. Then, the innovation in the next instant is obtained and the Kalman filter is reused. Thus, the dual control can be implemented. Finally, simulation results show that the control has dual property that can achieve preferable estimation results and satisfactory control performance.

articleTitle: Robust feature extracted by the generalized optimal discriminant vectors for face recognition
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel Gabor direct generalized optimal discriminant vectors (GDG-ODV) method for face recognition (FR). This method can apply directly the generalized optimal discriminant vectors (G-ODV) method that views the optimal set of discriminant vectors as a global transform to the high-dimensional augmented Gabor feature vectors (AGFV) derived from the Gabor wavelet representation of face images. This method has three novelties: 1) it is robust to the facial variations; 2) it can efficiently solve the small sample size problem (SSSP), which widely exists in FR tasks; 3) it can consider the separability of optimal discriminant vectors (ODV) from a global viewpoint. The GDG-ODV method is compared, in terms of classification accuracy, to other common methods on the ORL database. The results indicate that this method is overall superior to those various FR methods.

articleTitle: An application of reinforcement learning to voltage control in power system
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: A novel scheme based on the principle of reinforcement learning algorithm was proposed for the voltage control in power system. The controller adopted the adaptive heuristic critic (AHC) algorithm, which consists of two networks: action selection network and action critic network. The controller parameters are adjusted by given reinforcement signal of system. The numerical simulation example of single-machine infinite power system is given, and the result shows the designed control scheme can maintain desired voltage profile and prevent/stop a developing voltage collapse in system contingencies.

articleTitle: Neural network self-tuning PID control for boiler-turbine unit
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: In thermal power plant, conventional PID controller and direct energy balance (DEB) control strategy of coordinated control system (CCS), which are tuned at typical operating point, can hardly work well at different unit load. A novel self-tuning PID control strategy based on a two-level neural networks (NN) is proposed for CCS. The two level NNs are called static NN (SNN) and dynamic NN (DNN) respectively. SNN is used for PID controller arguments' primary tuning according to the system operating point such as unit load, in order to follow the wide range load changing; The two DNNs are used for PID fine tuning according to the error and error rate of the CCS, in order to overcome the small range load changing, system parameters' slow variance and some disturbance. Simulation results show that good dynamic regulating performance can be obtained by using the presented new method, and stronger robustness is obtained.

articleTitle: A computer vision based train boxcar transfer state real-time detection system
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: With economic development, the goods transport volume by railway runs up. The manual way of railway boxcar safe state checking cannot adapt to the development of railage more and more. This paper proposed a computer vision based boxcar safe state real-time monitoring system to substitute manual work. Line feature is extracted from the frame. By analyse the distribution of the line feature to differentiate the car type and the boxcar safe state. The little calculating amount of the algorithm and robustness to the noise and illumination disturbance makes it have good real-time quality and dependability. Experiment indicate that the system reach the design requirement.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of passively controlled anti-rolling tank
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The control equation was presented after analyzing air pressure conditions of passively controlled anti-rolling tank, whose air valve was connected to an air crossover pipe. And then the mathematical model of passively controlled anti-rolling tank was developed on the basis of theories of passive anti-rolling tank. The optimal control algorithm was proposed according to this mathematical model. The simulation results show that stabilization effect is the best when adopting optimal control algorithm in the non-resonance range. The passively controlled anti-rolling tank can reduce more roll magnitudes than those of passive anti-rolling tank.

articleTitle: Association-based approach to Web page recommendation
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Promoting the recall and precision of Web search engine is an important task for Web mining research. In the paper, an approach to Web page recommendation based on association is presented, which aims to produce recommendatory Web page links for user based on information associated tightly with users' query. The meaning and variety of association are introduced, and the method to realize Web page recommendation based on the association and generated associational information related with user's query is described. At last, the effectivity of the method is presented by a case study as the relevant experiment result.

articleTitle: State and input estimation for singular discrete-time systems with unknown inputs
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The problem of input decoupled observer design for singular discrete-time systems with unknown inputs was considered. When the system was causal controllable, under the nonsingular transformation, an equivalent problem for discrete-time standard state system was derived. First, an observer of discrete-time standard state system was designed using well-known techniques, and then the input decoupled observer of the singular discrete-time systems was obtained. Finally, the state and unknown input of the singular discrete-time systems are asymptotically estimated using the state of observer and output of systems.

articleTitle: Blind equalization algorithm based on LMS-Newton gradient
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: A new blind equalization algorithm based on LMS-Newton gradient is proposed. In order to decline complexity of algorithm and obtain faster convergence speed, a new cost function according to the principle of Euclidean distance is designed. The effectiveness of the new algorithm is illustrated by way of computer simulations.

articleTitle: Observer-based H/sub /spl infin// fault-tolerant control for descriptor linear systems with sensor failures
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Based on H/sub /spl infin// theory and state-observer theory in descriptor systems, a method of designing controllers for descriptor systems with sensor failures is presented. The controller designed by the proposed method can guarantee that the resultant closed-loop system is regular, impulse-free, stable and keeps certain H/sub /spl infin// norm performance in the normal conditions as well as in the event of sensor failures. A numerical example shows the effect of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The research on pheromone based dynamic intelligent scheduling for semiconductor wafer fabrication
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Semiconductor wafer fabrication cries for really dynamic intelligent scheduling method, due to its uncertainty, large-scale, reentrance, mixed processing, unbalanced-workload, etc. On the basis of analysis on self-organizing behaviors of ant colony system, pheromone-based multi-agent-system (MAS) for dynamic scheduling for semiconductor wafer fabrication facilities is presented, and an algorithm is proposed. There are mainly two kinds of ant agents in the pheromone-based MAS, i.e. workpiece ant agents and resource ant agents (including machine ant agents, transportation ant agents and operator ant agents). The coordination and cooperation between ant agents through pheromone make it possible to realize dynamic intelligent scheduling for semiconductor wafer fabrication facilities.

articleTitle: The study of linear radial basis function network
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: A special kind of RBF network, linear radial basis function network (LRBFN), was proposed. For LRBFN, the weight of a neuron has a relatively clear relationship with the distance between its center and the discriminant surface. Aimed to classify two kinds of samples, a two-stages training algorithm for LRBFN was given. In the first stage, the distance matrix of all samples is used to construct the discriminant surface; in the second stage, the neuron centers for LRBFN are reduced according to the weights in the previous stage. The experimental results show that LRBFN acts very well to solve classification problems.

articleTitle: Based on switched method linear systems reliable control
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: For linear systems, the switch method to design reliable controller is presented against actuator faults. By using strictly redundant reliable controller, standard controller is switched to reliable controller in the event of actuator faults. A more practical model of actuator faults than outage is considered. The resulting closed-loop systems are reliable in the sense that they provide guaranteed stability not only when all actuators are operational, but also when some actuator faults occur. Based on LMI, a sufficient condition for the existence of reliable control is given. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the design method. Furthermore, the standard system and the reliable system are compared to show the necessity of reliable control.

articleTitle: Two-parameter Hopf-bifurcation of HHM
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: It is reported that many diseases that are often termed as ion channel disease are related with the aberrance of cell trans-membrane ion channels. This paper took the Hodgkin-Huxley model for muscles as study object, on which the leakage conductance and the sodium ions anti-electromotive force was selected as the parameters to perform the two-parameters Hopf-bifurcation analysis. The influence of bifurcation on the H-H model was also discussed in this paper. With the aid of algebra criterion in high dimension equations, which can be used to prove the existence of Hopf-bifurcation, the task become easier. In addition, this paper also discussed the biological process and tried to prove that the aberrance occurred in the dynamic biological process is accounted for such diseases.

articleTitle: An H/sub /spl infin// fuzzy controller design via T-S fuzzy model and its application to hydrofoil catamaran
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: A less conservative LMI-based fuzzy H/sub /spl infin// controller via T-S (Tagaki-Sugeno) fuzzy model is proposed, and applied to attitude control for hydrofoil catamaran throughout its entire operating range. Firstly, a nonlinear system is represented by a T-S fuzzy model. Fuzzy robust control strategy is secondly presented with guaranteed H/sub /spl infin// control performance, which takes into consideration a much closer relationship between subsystems. In this method, the so-called PDC (parallel-distributed compensation) scheme is used to construct the H/sub /spl infin// fuzzy controller. Finally, based on hydrofoil catamaran, HB200B-A1, simulation researches demonstrate that the effectiveness of the H/sub /spl infin// fuzzy controller for attitude control of hydrofoil catamaran is used to attenuate external disturbances, such as waves and winds. It is shown that the drawback of conventional controller for hydrofoil catamaran can be overcome successfully, which is only efficient near the operating point.

articleTitle: An areal rainfall forecasting method based on fuzzy optimum neural network and Geography Information System
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: An areal rainfall is important basic data in a real time flood warning system. Good areal rainfall calculation means we can forecast flood more accurately and in time. Here, we propose an areal rainfall forecasting methodology integrated fuzzy optimized neural network with Geography Information System (GIS) methods. GIS has an advantage of processing spatial information. Using many models and methods provided by CIS software, we obtain more accurate areal rainfalls of a catchment. Then, these outputs of the CIS software are taken as the expected output of the fuzzy optimized neural network, and the network is trained to find the mapping between the areal rainfalls and observed rainfalls of all gauge stations. Finally, with the mapping, new observed values are taken as input of the network, and we can obtain the catchment areal rainfall in time.

articleTitle: Dynamic optimization of operation of heat-integrated distillation column systems
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Because of their higher efficiency of energy utilization, heat-integrated distillation columns are widely used in the chemical industry. The strong coupling of columns due to the heat integration leads to difficulties for control and optimization. This work concerns the dynamic optimization of heat-integrated columns, because such processes are often disturbed by product and feed switchover. We propose to use an efficient sequential optimization approach to determine dynamic policies for minimizing operating costs of such processes. The numerical algorithm for sensitivity computation is improved and the computational expense is significantly reduced. The approach is successfully applied to a rigorous model of a pilot two-pressure distillation column system.

articleTitle: Fuzzy sliding mode control of single electromagnet of MAGLEV vehicle
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: In order to improve the robustness of the electromagnetic suspension system of MAGLEV, the sliding mode controller is designed and applied, but the chattering phenomenon deteriorates the stabilization of system. The fuzzy controller is introduced in the boundary layer to slow down the speed of the states crossing the sliding surface. Through experiments, some conclusions can be drawn: this kind of fuzzy sliding mode controller has excellent robustness and the system chattering is smoothed.

articleTitle: On exponential stability criteria of stochastic age-dependent population
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: A class of stochastic age-dependent population dynamic system is introduced, and using Kolmogorou's inequality and Barkholder-Davis-Gundy's lemma, we can establish some criteria for the exponential stability of stochastic age-dependent population dynamic system.

articleTitle: Study on a snake-like robot adapting to the ground
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Biological snakes' diverse locomotion modes and physiology make them supremely adapted for the ground. This paper discusses the biological snakes' locomotion mode on the diverse ground, and describes the development of a snake-like robot with the adaptability for the ground. The method to realize some locomotion modes is given. The method for detecting the characteristic of ground is proposed and identified in test.

articleTitle: Economical operation of hydropower plant based on self-adaptive mutation evolutionary programming
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Aiming at dispatching the load among the units of hydropower plant, economical operation of hydropower plant (EOHP) should consider the stochastic aspect of water resources systems and electricity network. As a stochastic optimization procedure, evolutionary programming (EP) is proved to be useful in optimizing difficult functions. Prior to deterministic optimization methods, a self-adaptive mutation evolutionary programming (SEP) based method for EOHP is proposed, and a mathematical model is developed. In this model, the fitness function is constructed by including the constraints in the objective function as penalty terms. Comparison with traditional EP method, the example shows the effectiveness of SEP one.

articleTitle: Elastic object modeling in a VR-based telerobotic system
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: For successful teleoperation, it is crucial whether the telepresence can be realized in a sufficiently natural way, so that the operator may feel physically present at the remote site. This telepresence generation becomes more challenging, when the telerobotic system is employed to manipulate soft objects. In this paper, we propose a scheme on virtual object modeling for achieving realistic emulation of the object's behavior in the virtual environment. According to its physical property, the proposed modeling scheme generates the shape change of the object and also the corresponding reactive force during the deformation. Experiments based on using a VR-based telerobotic system developed in our laboratory to interact with elastic objects demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Using modular cascade DMC and balance control in the main steam temperature control of large power-plant boiler
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: As it is hard to put the control loop of main steam temperature in large power-plant boiler into automatic operating model, such as the #1 boiler of Pingwei power-plant, we acquired a good knowledge of the system characteristics and thought all the factors concerned over, then we took 10 factors into account and adopted modularized cascade dynamic matrix control method to solve the problem. This method solved the problem above perfectly, and its control performance index was bounded in 540/spl plusmn/3/spl deg/C, which was better than the request of national standard. To solve the off-balance of the output of the final-stage superheater, we got a new method, named balance control. These new control methods had the characteristics of online system identification, scrolling optimization and real-time feedback, so it could be used into the system with large time constant, large time delay and multiple disturbances.

articleTitle: A localized thresholding method based on boundary detection
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: A localized thresholding method based on boundary detection is proposed. The performance of global thresholding is likely to degrade when the gray level of the background in an image fluctuates and non-background regions with relatively large area exists. The proposed approach, localized thresholding based on boundary (LOTBOB), estimates the regions which are likely to contain the interesting objects by presuming that the appearance of boundaries indicates the existence of objects with a high possibility. Thresholding is then limited in these regions to avoid global thresholding. Experiments on real-world images show that LOTBOB is effective with relatively small and clearly-edged objects.

articleTitle: A multiobjective genetic algorithm for distributed database management
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: It is important to reduce access latency and network traffic in distributed database management problem (DDMP). This problem has been formulated as a multiobjective combinatorial optimization problem in the paper. A new approach is proposed that is an intelligent configuration with multiple objectives based on genetic algorithm. Multiple criteria are developed with a goal to provide trade-off optimal performance for Web services. A set of good configurations with diverse spread of DDMP is generated to approximate Pareto front of the optimization problem. The corresponding results demonstrate that the proposed approach is capable of discovering a set of nondominated configurations within a finite genetic generation. Its feasibility and performance has been verified.

articleTitle: Multi-rate output feedback control of nonlinear systems
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: An existing stable multi-rate sampled output feedback linear controller design method for linear systems is extended to nonlinear systems. General output feedback nonlinear controller design methods for nonlinear systems with perturbation are investigated too. Stabilizability and robustness conditions for such nonlinear multi-rate sampled output feedback control systems are derived.

articleTitle: Realization of routing in mobile IP based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Due to the excellent performance in optimum problem, we choose the genetic algorithm to realize the routing algorithm via designated node in mobile IP protocol. In order to get the shortest routing via home agent from the correspondent node to the mobile node, we introduced three schemes into the algorithm. Detachment of the population and bi-direction development in selection strategy could make the diversity of population abundant. In addition, the restriction on passing the designated node in the first population initialization and crossover operation gave a better efficiency to the algorithm. Thus, results show that the proposed method was to be proved useful for routing problem via designated node.

articleTitle: Design of combination hybrid adaptive controller for the burning system of drum boiler
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: As the burning system of drum boiler is a nonlinear big-lagged system, it is very difficult to achieve better tracking control performances and robustness by traditional PID and classical control theories. Based on the dynamic peculiarity analysis of the burning system, a combination hybrid adaptive control scheme was designed. It included a few hybrid adaptive controllers, these controllers merged to work, the control signal was obtained by weighting the output signals of the few controllers. Theoretical analysis and test results show that the scheme is effective to solve the nonlinear big-lagged peculiarity, has quick adaptability and strong robustness. The results show that efficiency prospects for its further applications on power systems.

articleTitle: Modeling study of sludge process based on neural network
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: On the basis of analyzing the classical methods of sludge process modeling, the paper put forward a new method about activated sludge process by neural networks. Firstly, the paper utilized principal component analysis method to realize reduce the dimension of the input vectors and orthogonalize the components of the input vectors. Then built activated sludge process system by BP and RBF artificial neural networks, the applicability of the two neural network models were analyzed to sludge process. The experiment result shows that: (1) these neural networks may reflect real conditions correctly and have strong self-adaptation; (2) the RBF neural network model has better convergence ability and impending speed than the BP neural network model.

articleTitle: Special overlapping decomposition for interconnected power systems
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Three decomposition algorithms are presented in this paper, by investigating the topological structures of special multi-area overlapping interconnected power systems. The power system is decomposed from a longitudinal, a loop or a radial overlapping interconnected structure to a group of pair-wise areas and/or subsystems. Therefore, automatic generation control (AGC) of the system can establish its own overlapping decentralized control. Overlapping decomposition factor, chosen by a rating load ratio between areas or subsystems, can improve decentralized control quality of AGC against the disturbances of load-frequency and tie-line power exchange, so as to meet the need of AGC economic operation for the power system.

articleTitle: Research on soft sensing model via FCM-based distributed ANFIS and its application
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Originated from the idea of combining several models to improve prediction accuracy and robustness, a new method for nonlinear soft sensing modeling was proposed. Fuzzy c-means clustering (FCM) algorithm was adopted to separate a whole training data set into several subsets with different centers, each subset was trained by adaptive neural-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS). Subsets outputs were integrated by fuzzy cluster so as to obtain the final result. This model has been evaluated and applied to loose of jig bed. The simulation and practical application demonstrate that this model has good generalization result, good prediction accuracy and wide potential application online.

articleTitle: Track to track fusion based on NFE model
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Due to the bad performance of the common method for track to track fusion under complicated disturbing environment and radar netting dynamically, an algorithm for track to track fusion based on NFE model (neural network-fuzzy reasoning-expert system) is proposed. By making good use of the self-learning, self-reasoning ability and robustness of fuzzy neural network and expert system, this approach can adapt to the changes of the system environment and find the optimal algorithm. Simulation results show that this algorithm can still get results with high precision even under various complicated conditions such as sensors' reliabilities being low, a large amount of outliers existing in the whole measurement data set, sensors broken down or destroyed, radars netting over again, and so on.

articleTitle: Identification of time-varying delay systems using particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Particle swarm optimization algorithm is a new evolutionary computation method, which is applicable to complex optimization problems that are nonlinear, nondifferentiable and multimodal. A method for identification of time-varying delay systems using particle swarm optimization is proposed. The basic idea of the method is that the identification problems are cast as mixed-integer nonlinear programming problems, and then particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to find the optimal estimation of the time-varying parameters. Simulation results reveal that the suggested identification scheme possesses a good tracking ability to the time-varying delay systems.

articleTitle: Infinite-eigenvalue assignment for descriptor systems via state variable feedback
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Firstly, the parametric form of the variable K in the matrix pencil A+BK was given, such that when K varied in R/sup n/spl times/n/ and A was nonsingular, A+BK was nonsingular. Based on it and matrix equation theory, a sufficient and necessary condition was obtained to make the infinite-eigenvalue assignment for descriptor systems solvable by state variable feedback, that was to find K such that the close-loop descriptor system (E, A+BK) only has infinite eigenvalues. Finally, an algorithm to solve the problem was presented, and a numerical example was included to demonstrate the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Calculating method of PID controllers stability region
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: A fast calculating method of PID controllers stability region shows that for a fixed value of the proportional term(k/sub p/) the stabilizing PID controllers form a finite set of disjoint polyhedral sets in the parameter space. A complete characterization and a receivable method of stabilizing regions are proposed. It is possible to bound the stabilizing values of k/sub p/. This way provides fast and easy calculation of the stabilizing PID compensators for a given system.

articleTitle: Study on satisfactory predictive control algorithm for complex systems
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The satisfactory predictive control for complex system is studied. By introducing commanding input and the membership degrees of the predictive output errors between the predictive outputs and their setpoints, the satisfactory predictive control algorithm is improved. Using the satisfactory control algorithm presented in this paper, it cannot only avoid the solving of Diophantine equation for calculating the predictive output, but also deal with the setpoint control problem and horizon control problem, while the hard constraints are guaranteed, the soft constraints and the output tracking are satisfied as much as possible. The simulation results verify the validity.

articleTitle: Comparisons of the performance on transient chaotic neural network with different output functions
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Based on the chaotic simulated annealing network used by Chen & Aihara, which has better searching properties than traditional Hopfield-Tank neural network, we proposed other two different output functions and applied all of them to 4 city TSP respectively. We constructed continuous, discrete and continuous-discrete neural networks, introduced a basic principle to initialize parameter. At last, we analyzed the performance of chaotic neural networks with different output functions, which were measured in terms of feasibility, research efficiency, scalability, convergence speed and computing cost.

articleTitle: Swarm intelligence based design of intelligent house embedded system
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: A swarm intelligence is introduced into the analysis and design of intelligent house in this paper. The system performance, software and hardware framework, and the module function of the intelligent house system are discussed thoroughly. The general framework of the realized intelligent house embedded system is derived. Software framework of the system is based on Web and XML technology, which can be highly modularized and easily developed, tested and maintained. Based on the network technology, the control of the electric equipment is focused upon its independent intelligent control characteristics. The core of the hardware framework is a 32-bit embedded processor. The circumstance control of the intelligent house is implemented with the technology of communication, sensors and computer networks.

articleTitle: Delay-dependent robust control for a class of nonlinear state-delayed systems
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The robust control was dealt with for a class of nonlinear systems with state-delays. The parameter uncertainties are assumed to be time-varying norm-bounded. It is seen that the unknown nonlinear functions depend on current and past states, respectively. By constructing a novel Lyapunov-Krasoyskii function, a delay-dependent sufficient condition was derived in terms of linear matrix inequality (LMI) such that the resultant closed-loop system is robust asymptotically stable.

articleTitle: Dynamic system modeling based on rough sets and RBF neural networks
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Rough set is a powerful mathematical tool, which can deal with fuzzy and uncertain knowledge, and radial basis function (RBF) neural network has the ability to approach any nonlinear function precisely. A dynamic modeling method is presented using the rough sets and RBF network for complex system. The method is applied to model the steam turbine generators with complex dynamic characteristics and uncertainties. The simulation results prove the validity of this method.

articleTitle: XML-based complex lab data representing, storing and publishing
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The problem of heterogeneous data integration in industrial supervisory control is presented and analyzed. The demand and difficulties of complex lab data representing, storing and publishing are outlined and analyzed in this paper. It is pointed out that a self-descriptive data structure with clear organization of contents and easy connection to human-machine interface is needed. A solution based on XML (eXtended Mark-up Language) is proposed with combination of different layers of data storage, data logic and presentation, human-machine interface. An XML-based system is developed to meet the demands of laboratory data publishing with complex structure. Construction of user interface from XML schema, conversion of lab data into XML, algorithm of storing XML into RDBMS (relation database manager system), query and reconstruction of XML documents from the RDBMS are touched upon. The data structure is described in details and its unique advantage is presented.

articleTitle: Optimal design of liquid dampers for torsionally coupled vibration of structures
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: In this paper, tuned liquid column dampers (TLCD) and circular tuned liquid column dampers (CTLCD) are used to control the torsionally coupled vibration of structures subjected to multidimensional earthquake excitations. The optimal parameters of the liquid dampers are designed for the structures excited by bi-directional seismic based on the genetic algorithms (GAs). Two kinds of target functions are used in this paper. The first one concerns the maximum structural floor response and the second deals with the responses of all structural degrees. A 12-story eccentric structure model is selected as an example. The results show that the optimal parameters with the second target function can effectively control the translational responses in x and y directions as well as the torsional response.

articleTitle: A novel method of measuring phase deviation signal for Coriolis mass flow meter
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: A new phase deviation signal detecting method based on signal capture technology is presented to deal with the signals of double u-shaped Coriolis mass flow meter. By using the method, MCU (micro control unit) can get the whole oscillating information of the flow sensor, including normal phase deviation signal being proportional to mass flow rate and signal draft caused by noises. MCU can easily identify and delete the combined interfering signals by a simple algorithm in the software. And it can improve the anti-jamming ability and measurement accuracy. The method was implemented by using high performance MSP430F149 MCU of the Texas Instrument company. This simplified the hardware system of the signal processing board and reduced the price and energy consumption greatly.

articleTitle: Speech conversion from clean conditions to telephone ones
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: This paper addresses the application in speech recognition of simulated telephone speech, which is generated from clean speech by approximately mimicking actual telephone channel conditions. Maximum Likelihood Linear Regression (MLLR) algorithm was performed to conduct experiments on evaluating the performances of HMM recognizers, which were trained from clean speech and from generated telephone data, respectively. The test and adaptation data were recorded by piping clean speech through local telephone network. The experiments without adaptation report that the simulation models trained on generated data can give an obviously higher rate than the clean speech. The adaptation performances show that MLLR lends itself to further improve the recognition performance of telephone recognition system. The results show that telephone speech recognition performance can be effectively improved using the generated data, and its generating method can reduce the acoustic mismatch between training and testing data that was induced by the shortage of actual telephone speech.

articleTitle: A novel adaptive wavelet network and application
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: It is difficult for traditional network model to overcome the uncertainties of industrial process. The disadvantage was improved by one novel adaptive wavelet network in a way. First a simple adaptive algorithm was given, and the adaptive performance was analyzed. Then a predictive model for hot finishing rolling natural width change was constructed, including two parts, offline wavelet network model and a simple adaptive algorithm online. Finally the novel adaptive wavelet predictive model was used to forecast the slab width change of the finishing rolling based on practical production data. The simulation results show that this novel method is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Admissible initial value sets and dynamic feedback control of nonlinear differential-algebraic systems
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: In this paper, the admissible initial value set and dynamic feedback control of nonlinear differential-algebraic systems are considered. An algorithm to calculate the admissible initial value set is given. Based on the algorithm, the differential-algebraic system can be transformed to a standard state space system constrained in an invariant set. If the standard state space system constrained in the invariant set can be stabilized then the original differential-algebraic system can be stabilized by a dynamic feedback controller.

articleTitle: Researches on TCP congestion control mechanism for differentiated services
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: DiffServ (differentiated services) can provide for corresponsive quality of service according to different consumers with different service requirements. TCP flows play a very important part in Internet. TCP congestion control algorithm based on window limits bandwidth required fairly with big RTT link, so that it limits its support with DiffServ. This paper presents an active queue mechanism, EBLUE, to support DiffServ. By combining EBLUE with an enhanced TCP congestion control mechanism, we investigate how TCP supports assured service and achieves fair bandwidth share among connections.

articleTitle: The selection of the basic ECG wave
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Some algorithms such as statistical analysis, wavelet analysis and cluster analysis are derived through analysing 296 sample ECGs and the heart rate is selected as the criteria for these algorithms. The comparing our results using several computing methods with the true heart rates of ECG, which come from doctors, shows that our result approaches to the truth. The accurate percentage of the computing result shows the wavelet method is more powerful and faster than statistical analysis.

articleTitle: Discrete-time quasi-sliding mode control for input constrained systems
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: In this paper, a quasi-sliding mode control strategy for discrete-time uncertain systems with input constraints is proposed. The quasi-sliding mode controllers are designed based on the quality of the equivalent control, and the width of the quasi-sliding mode band is reduced effectively. Comparing with other published methods by simulations, this strategy guarantee better robustness, faster states convergence, and improved steady state accuracy of the system.

articleTitle: Agile supply chain based virtual enterprise modeling with fuzzy evaluation
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Agile supply chain (ASC) based virtual enterprise (VE) with integrated resources of its partners has more advantages in the competitive market. Detail structure and interior procedure of a VE organization are presented. ASC based partner selecting model technologies of VE have been studied with a new modeling method of fuzzy evaluation. An instantiation is illustrated to demonstrate the modeling method.

articleTitle: The application of multi-objectives optimization methods in mine hoist design
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: In this paper, more detailed analyses on drum shell's structure of the new drum hoist, according to the deformed conditions between the support wheels and shell, and the stresses distribution are obtained under radial press, bending moment and torsion. At the same time, multi-objectives optimization methods were used to solve the hoist design. It was useful to promote the design methods of the mine hoist in theory and practice.

articleTitle: Cluster model for flight demand forecasting
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Traditional models of flight demand forecasting put great emphasis on the relationship of data features between historical flights and current flights. However, these models are not suitable for the frequent changes of flight schedule, which is a situation we often face. To adapt to this situation, a forecasting model of flight demand cluster was presented. Booking procedure was defined as a vector that grew in length when near departure and multi-pass program was used in this model. Compared with regression model and pickup model that are popular in practice, the results of the model have shown its efficiency in computation speed, robustness and accurateness. This model has been applied to Xiamen Airline of China successfully and the results also have shown a good effect in practice.

articleTitle: An open loop subspace model identification algorithm for closed loop system
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: A novel identification algorithm using Q-Markov cover for subspace system operating in closed loop has been proposed. A set of new formulas for reconstruction of the open loop model is derived and the algorithm only needs some linear algebraic knowledge. The unique solution of the open loop subspace model for the general structure of the closed loop is obtained, and the existing conditions for the solution could be used as the identified model criteria index. The algorithm for direct feedback controller and state feedback controller situation is analyzed. Simulation results have shown that the new algorithm is successful.

articleTitle: Reliable descriptor systems design using redundant controllers
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The problem of design reliable generalized controllers based on observers using multiple identical controllers for descriptor systems is studied. The resulting closed-loop, descriptor systems are admissible and H/sub /spl infin// performance, not only when all controllers are operational but also when some sensors and/or actuators outages occur.

articleTitle: Markov decision problems with unbounded transition rates under discounted-cost performance criteria
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: We discuss the problems of discounted-cost performance optimization for a class of countable Markov control processes (CMCP) with (possibly) unbounded transition rates. The discounted Poisson equation is proposed for a CMCP, from which /spl alpha/-potential is defined. The optimality equation based on the /spl alpha/-potential is derived under the conditions weaker than those previously known.

articleTitle: Research and accomplishment of OMFDS in /spl plusmn/50 MVAr cascade STATCOM
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: This paper introduces an operation monitoring and fault diagnosis system (OMFDS) based on CANBUS and optical fiber connection. It is designed for a /spl plusmn/50 MVAr cascade STATCOM system. According to voltages, currents and other data collected via CANBUS network, it can accurately determine operating conditions of the STATCOM system and provide comprehensive real-time supervision. This OMFDS has been proved successful in the /spl plusmn/50 MVAr cascade STATCOM system, and could be easily adapted to other FACTS/DFACTS devices.

articleTitle: A point correlation based subpixel image registration algorithm
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: This paper presents a fast image registration algorithm with sub-pixel accuracy for IC package industry. The algorithm is based on point correlation method and improved mainly in two aspects. One is using entropy as correlation measure function and the other is proposing pair-wise exchange algorithm to obtain the pre-defined set of points. It also includes spline interpolation model that ensures the algorithm with sub-pixel accuracy. Simulation results confirm the validity of the presented algorithm.

articleTitle: The design and simulation software of state feedback predictive control systems constrained by multiple variables
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: This software was based on the time-delay dependent state feedback predictive control (DDSFPC) and considered all factors encountered in the field. These factors included the model uncertainty, the state variable time-delay uncertainty, the manipulated variable time-delay uncertainty, the measurable and the unmeasurable disturbance, the restriction of the controller, the restriction of the controller's adjusting rate and the restriction of the controlled variable. Simulation results of the open-loop system and the close-loop system were shown. Those satisfying results could be saved as files. The software has the friendly interface and it is a powerful tool for the design of the predictive controller.

articleTitle: Nonlinear blind source separation based on radial basis function
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Radial basis function (RBF) neural network is used as a de-mixing system for nonlinear blind source separation (BSS). The nonlinear mixing mapping is assumed to exist and able to be approximated using RBF network. The object criterion is based on the maximum entropy (ME) approach. To ensure the entropy of the outputs has upper bounded, a special sigmoid function is introduced to the output of the network. The cost function, which maximizes the output entropy of the sigmoid function, is defined to separate the nonlinear mixture. The natural gradient descent method is applied in maximizing entropy. Simulation results are presented to demonstrate the feasibility, robustness and computability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Developmentally cognitive robot vision
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: A generic methodology for designing developmental cognitive robot vision systems was proposed to add development capability to cognitive vision systems. Four issues were discussed: (1) human-like architecture suitable for different visual purposes, (2) efficient memory organization, forming, and indexing mechanism proper for emergence of machine imagery and experience-based learning, (3) life-like development model for open-ended cognitive improvement and perception development, and (4) engineering methodology to treat the robot intelligence embodiment as a life-like process combining evolution, development and learning mechanisms. Their possible solutions were also provided: (1) a so-called dual-visual system and dual-memory architecture framework, (2) an "interaction procedure recording" theory plus a new ecological neural evolution approach to solve the interaction and binding problem between dual visual systems, (3) a development model based on a novel hybrid intelligent system theory embedding memory and communication as its inner components, and (4) a four-phase robot life-span development schema for behavior engineering.

articleTitle: Communicating FSM partitioning for front end embedded software synthesis
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Nowadays embedded software is facing more and more pressure of time to market (TTM). In order to shorten the development cycle and improve the quality of development, formal method has been widely used in embedded software development process. Usually formal method is applied as a specification method to clearly define and design systems, but recently automatic implementation has attracted intensive interests. Although there are some available commercial tools for formal method based embedded software synthesis, the generated code is acceptable for only prototyping because of its poor quality. Optimized embedded software synthesis is the key to bring out the maximal potential of formal method based embedded software development. The optimal partitioning of formal specification is a significant step in front-end embedded software synthesis, because improper partitioning incur both code explosion and poor performance. Our work is based on communicating FSM (CFSM), because CFSM is the basis of many development methods and tools, and the goal is to achieve the best performance under the constraints of code size. We formulated the partitioning problem taking into account profiling information. In order to search the tremendous solution space efficiently, genetic algorithm is applied.

articleTitle: The application of adaptive notch filter in the cab signal analysis
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: It is difficult to reduce the noise signal in the cab signal by normal filter because the frequency is similar to that of the modulated signal. So, the adaptive theory is introduced to realize the noise signal canceling. Through the analysis of the working principle and the theory of ratiocination, this paper designed a multi-frequency adaptive notch filter and applied it in the cab signal analysis to cancel the odd times of 50 Hz noise signals. From the experiment data, we can see that the effect of the adaptive notch filter is outstanding that can satisfy the requirement of the cab signal analysis.

articleTitle: A SVD-based optimal filtering for multi-channel system with correlated multiplicative noises
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: An optimal filtering recursive algorithm was proposed for multi-channel system with correlated multiplicative noises among observation channels. The system is under the condition that the multiplicative noises are general stochastic matrix and correlated in each observation channel at the same time. Considering the numerical stability of the algorithm, an equivalent algorithm based on singular value decomposition (SVD) was given for the same system. The SVD algorithm, as well as the previous algorithm, is optimal in the sense of linear minimum-variance. Simulation examples to demonstrate the performance of both algorithms show that the algorithm based on SVD has higher computational precision and numerical stability.

articleTitle: A digital filter for application in robot wrist force sensor
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: Aimed at dynamic behavior compensation and its realization for robot wrist force sensor, a new design method for digital filter-pole-zero matched method based on bilinear transformation is developed in this paper. The design idea and the steps of this method are given. A design example and discussion are presented to show the features of the method. A dynamic compensation filter used in wrist force sensor is designed using the method developed in the paper, which improves dynamic performance of sensor efficiently.

articleTitle: Stabilizing control of a class of robot manipulators with input delay
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: A design method of stabilizing controller for a class of robot manipulator is proposed. The synthesis problem of the controller via memoryless state feedback is solved based on LMI. A numerical example illustrates the results.

articleTitle: Uncertainty network planning methodology based on the connection number a+bi+cj
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The connection number a+bi+cj, a new kind of number introduced in set pair analysis (SPA) theory, was used in uncertain network planning methodology to represent the uncertainty and delay of working procedure time. It is caused by random, fuzzy, indeterminate-known or unforeseen factors and unexpected incident in a project. The concepts of primary critical paths, secondary critical paths and third critical paths with the classifying method of critical paths in uncertainty environment were introduced. A new uncertainty network planning method is constructed, which is different from the traditional concept and more consistent with the practical application. The new concept can obtain three different sets of critical paths instead of only one critical path obtained by traditional one. The illustrating examples given in this paper indicate that the new method can provide more useful information for the finish time forecasting and controlling of a project.

articleTitle: fIntegrating confidence scores for utterance verification
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: In this paper we present an approach to integrating confidence scores for utterance verification based on neural network. In addition to the confidence scores computed at the phonetic level, we use various novel confidence scores, including segmental confidence scores, likelihood ratio and recognition results of LPC feature. We describe a method to combine different confidence scores via a neural work for word hypotheses. Our experimental evaluation shows that the novel confidence scores are effective and the proposed combination method gives better results than other classification method in keyword spotting system.

articleTitle: Optimization decision system for operational parameters in the process of matter converting
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: An optimization decision system for operational parameters in the process of matter converting is developed. In this paper, the offline optimization decision model for blustering parameters based on neural networks and chaotic genetic algorithm is discussed in detail. A neural network is employed to approximate the function of blustering parameters with state parameters, and an improved chaotic genetic algorithm is used to search the more optimal blustering parameters. At last, the functional modules of the system are listed, and the industrial application is introduced. The practical result shows that the output of converter increases by 6%, and the quantity of cool materials treated rises by 7.8%.

articleTitle: A common model controller
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: In order to overcome the weakness of generic model control (GMC), i.e., its response profile is a pseudo-second-order curve, by embedding the process model into the controller, we propose a common model controller (CMC), so that the controlled system can yield the same response as a classic second-order system in the non constrained manipulated input and perfect model parameters. The parameters of CMC are of very explicit physic meaning and it is very easy to tune for the controller. The simulations for a nonlinear pressure tank show the effectiveness of the common model controller.

articleTitle: Cancer molecular classification based on support vector machines
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: A method based on support vector machines is proposed for cancer molecular classification. The Bhattacharyya distance of each gene is calculated as the criterion for filtering 'noisy-genes' which do not contribute to classification, and then based on the expression values of the informative genes, a linear support vector machine is used as the classifier to classify different cancers. This process has been applied to the human acute leukemia dataset as a test case. The effectiveness and feasibility of the method is proved by the results that all the samples in the dataset can be correctly classified without any error.

articleTitle: Congestion control based on predictive control in ATM networks
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The ABR service of ATM networks uses a rate-based feedback control mechanism to adapt to varying link capacity left by high-priority CBR/VBR transmission. Control theory is proposed to offer the general means for designing congestion control algorithms for ABR service. Under the consideration of the effects of multiple loop delays and high-priority CBR/VBR transmission, this paper proposes a GPC (general predictive control) method to control traffic where sources adjust their transmission rates to avoid congestion. The controller keeps the queue level at the bottleneck node to the desired steady-state value and satisfies fair bandwidth distribution. Simulation study verifies the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Regional signal coordinated control system based on an ant algorithm
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The presented regional signal coordinated control system includes a macroscopic traffic prediction model and an ant algorithm to search the global optimal signal settings. The prediction model is based on a platoon dispersion model. With the definition of a layered construction graph to represent the corresponding solution space and the definition of the local heuristic information with the transient traffic delay of individual intersections, the ant algorithm can not only find the global optimal solution but also realize smooth switch between different signal settings. The simulation results of a network with 9 intersections demonstrate that the performance of this system is evidently better than the traffic responsive control system of isolated intersections.

articleTitle: QF alike coordination mechanism in base stock controlled supply channel
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: We investigated a simple supply chain facing stationary stochastic demand with constant components replenishment lead-time. Holding costs are charged for final product inventory, demands are backordered when can't be fulfilled in time and penalty costs are charged not only on the retailer but also on the supplier. Inventory decision of the retailer deviates from the system optimal due to double marginal effect and system performance is debased. Here, we try to design mechanism that is like quantity flexible in Newsboy model to coordinate the decentralized system. Such a mechanism is given to allocate cost arbitrarily.

articleTitle: A sales forecasting model for manufacturer in hybrid supply chain
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: In view of the characteristics of sales forecasting of manufacturer in hybrid supply chain (HSC), an extended recursive forgetting factor forecasting (ERFFF) model was given in this paper. The coefficient vector in this model is altered dynamically with the actual data, and the optimum structural parameters are adjusted according to the Theil U statistic, thus the best forecasting value is acquired under the optimal state. Through a practical case, it was proven the greater accuracy and applied value of this model.

articleTitle: MINLP algorithms mixed with constraint programming
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: This paper advanced mixed integer nonlinear programming (MINLP) algorithms mixed with constraint programming (CP) to solve industrial process hybrid model mixed with logical rule. CP methods have proved to be successful in solving highly constrained discrete optimization and feasibility problems. It can effectively solve hybrid model mixed with logical rule by integrating CP, nonlinear programming and mixed integer linear programming. Computational results demonstrated this algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on applications of the logistic routine problem with enhanced ant algorithm
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The structure of logistic routine problem described corresponding to the structure and parameters of M-TSP is studied. The optimizing method of the main logistic routine problem is brought forward. To deal with the M-TSP, which has the constrains and optimizing objectives of logistic routine problem, the optimizing methods are presented. The combinatorial optimization problem which is NP-complete in M-TSP is solved by enhanced ant algorithm. Simulations on some different dimensions of TSP examples have shown that the ant algorithm has effective convergence with good robustness and is supposed to be practical.

articleTitle: Tank volume control with pump failure: a case study in the mixed logic dynamic system
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The logic relationship between [f (x) < 0] and [/spl delta/ = 1] is deduced to supplement the logic rules in the mixed logical dynamical (MLD) system framework. Then, the models of a process control experiment consisting of piecewise linear functions are rewritten, in order to optimize the control parameter, which is originally determined by thousand times of simulations. Two simulations of the control experiment, a "slow switch" one and a "fast switch" one, are performed, and the transient state analysis are provided.

articleTitle: High-order sliding mode control for generators
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: In this paper, high-order sliding mode has been employed for excitation system of the synchronous generator. First, the model of the synchronous generator is transformed to singular perturbation nonlinear system, and then the sliding mode controller is designed for fast and slow sub-system; since the states are not completely measurable, we applied the sub-optimal algorithm to ensure the existence of the high-order sliding mode and asymptotic stability of the system. The simulation results are given at last.

articleTitle: Using classification and key phrase extraction for information retrieval
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology and the great capacities of online documents, information retrieval has become a major research topic. In this paper, a new information retrieval algorithm is proposed, which can reduce time complexity and improve accuracy using classification and key phrase extraction. Then a new criterion named ranking error is contributed to solve the problem that the traditional performance evaluation methodology can't evaluate the ranking results of retrieved documents effectively. The experimental results indicate that the proposed algorithm outperforms vector space model and interactive retrieval based on classification in speed, accuracy and ranking error.

articleTitle: Catastrophe analysis of submarine in dive plane
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: The problem of multiple steady state solutions in the dive plane of submarine under depth control is analyzed. Generic solution branching is shown to occur below a critical Froude number. Bifurcation analysis and catastrophe theory techniques are employed to quantify the effects that various vehicle geometric properties and hydrodynamic characteristics have on steady state motion.

articleTitle: A further study of nonlinear feedback system with chaotic oscillation
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: This paper studies a simple nonlinear feedback system that consists of a relay-hysteresis in feedback with a linear continuous-time unstable second-order system. With suitable parameters and initial conditions, the system can create chaos. The analytic solutions on occurrence chaos and the criterion for maximum stability margin of chaos are presented.

articleTitle: Robust adaptive fuzzy control for a class of uncertain nonlinear systems
publicationTitle: Fifth World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation (IEEE Cat. No.04EX788)
abstract: A novel scheme of direct robust adaptive fuzzy control for a class of strict-feedback uncertain systems with both unknown virtual control gain functions and unknown nonlinearities is proposed in this paper.
